abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Brostamide lowers systolic drop compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Brostamide lowers systolic drop compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Oakfield Family Cohort.

Table 5. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Systolic drop | 9.9 | 5.0 | 600 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 10.1 | 5.0 | 600 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 9.6 | 4.8 | 600 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Systolic drop | 10.1 | 5.0 | 600 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 7.0 | 3.5 | 600 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 9.7 | 4.8 | 600 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
